title: SEED's copy clause read in the knots
objective: MID-RULE-20261118-001's first direction, with the coordinator's go-ahead: a local rule that never adds a crossing cannot pull in a split the first fill left uncrossed. SEED does, by its copy clause, with fills that have two end knots. Can the knots near such a fill tell an absorbing fill (accepted by SEED, keeps two orders) from a refused one that makes a crossing? Tiers: the move's knots, the betweenness among its distinctions, and the knots one step out, with held-out scoring. Serves G1 and G16; challenges A101.
stop_rule: One proof and one frozen computation with its read-out; referee hand-off; report.
